name: ERPvP Main Ladder Rules

sources.planner: ER Build Planner rulesets file (rulesets-*.js), 'ER PvP Ladder (Seamless Co-op/Den Maps)' + '(Vanilla)', lastUpdate 2026-03-21 — use its structured format/item mapping as the base

duel.start: both players finish the bow gesture
rules: No respec or character swap during a match
Follow Elden Ring ToS (no macros, no third-party tools)
Manual attack aiming must be disabled in the BMP mod
No advantage applied before the duel (pre-buffs)
Pre-loading a crossbow, bow or ash of war counts as a pre-buff
Switching builds is prohibited once in the same world as the opponent
Grease buffs must be gone before swapping to a setup that bans them
Equipping banned content counts as using it (equipping a banned AoW but not using it is an exception)
Accidental use counts as intended use unless the opponent permits
Requests to show your build after the match cannot be denied
Breaking a rule or message heals = round loss

general: Player buffs that stay regardless of equipped weapon (excludes crystal tears, talismans, equipment, armour)

HP healing: Flask of Crimson Tears, healing incantations (Urgent Heal, Heal, Great Heal, Erdtree Heal, Lord's Heal, Blessing's Boon, Blessing of the Erdtree, Bestial Vitality, Heal from Afar), healing consumables (Raw Meat Dumpling, Warming Stone, Frenzyflame Stone, Baldachin's Blessing, Radiant Baldachin's Blessing)
Rune Arc and PvP Great Runes: allowed in Better Multiplayer / Seamless; banned in vanilla
Spectral Steed Whistle and Spirit Ashes
Blocking with shields above 90% physical absorption

Consumables: Ironjar Aromatic, Sacred Bloody Flesh, all Livers (Fireproof/Lightningproof/Spellproof/Holyproof Dried & Pickled Liver, Opaline Pickled Liver), Ancient Dragon's Blessing, Boiled Crab, Boiled Prawn, Exalted Flesh
greases: Sleep greases (Soporific, Drawstring Soporific, Eternal Sleep, Drawstring Eternal Sleep) on Ripple weapons (Ripple Blade, Ripple Crescent Halberd)
All greases on the buff-restricted setups (buffRestrictions)
All other damage greases (incl. DLC and Drawstring) are ALLOWED
weapons: Thrusting Shields (class) — incl. Carian Thrusting Shield; Dueling Shield 2H
Power-stanced Backhand Blades (class, incl. Reverse-Bladed Sword)
Pata: allowed ONLY in the off hand
2H Stone Club/Club with any status application (status infusion or status grease)
ashesOfWar: Chilling Mist applied on cold-infused weapons
talismans: All i-frame-affecting talismans (Crucible Feather, Fine Crucible Feather, Talisman of All Crucibles)
Ash-of-war damage talismans: Shard of Alexander, Warrior Jar Shard
spells: Absorption-increasing incantations: Golden Vow, Flame, Grant Me Strength, Protection of the Erdtree

buffRestrictions.description: All greases, spells and ashes of war that buff a weapon are banned on:
targets: Off-hand Hatchets = the whole Axe class
2H Great Spears (class) except Mohgwyn's Sacred Spear

blacklistedGlitches: Circumventing effect duration or tick rate
engineNotes: Implement rules in the planner's structured form (banned / restricted-setup with main/off/is2H/infusions/except, stat rules) mapped to data ids; this file is the human-readable source of truth.
Unmapped names must be reported, never silently ignored.
Duel-start presets must not use banned talismans (e.g. Shard of Alexander).
allowedExplicitly: Godskin Swaddling Cloth (heals on hits, not tick-based)
All damage greases except those listed under bans.greases

items: Discord screenshots are the latest source; planner-only items (planner rulesets file, 2026-03-21) also apply
Planner's blanket 'All Damage Greases' ban is outdated — greases are banned only on listed weapons/setups
Crimson Bubbletear is allowed; the HP-recovery ban targets tick-based regen
Pata allowed in off hand only
'2H Backhand Blade' bans the weapon Backhand Blade only, not the class
Power-stanced Backhand Blades is a class ban; it covers the Reverse-Bladed Sword (planner category Backhand Blade)

'Reverse Blades' = the weapon Reverse-Bladed Sword (id 64530000), matched by name: Lightning infusion banned when 2H, all weapon buffs banned when 2H, everything else legal (incl. 2H on other infusions)
2H Stone Club/Club: any status application is banned, whether from the infusion or a grease

'Fast Sword Dance' = the ash Sword Dance on the light-weapon tier (Dagger, Throwing Blade, Straight Sword, Light Greatsword, Curved Sword, Katana, Axe, Backhand Blade); Great Katana is in the great-weapon tier and stays legal (2026-11-13)
